meta.title: LearnQ - AI-Based Question Answer Generation from Videos

summary: Developed an AI-powered platform that automatically generates question-answer pairs from educational video content. The system processes video transcripts, extracts contextual information, and generates structured QA datasets for learning and assessment applications.

challenge.description: Creating educational question-answer datasets manually from long video content is time-consuming and difficult to scale. The challenge was to build an automated system capable of understanding contextual information from videos and generating meaningful, high-quality QA pairs.

methodology.title: Video Processing & Transcription
methodology.description: Implemented an automated pipeline to process video content and generate accurate transcripts using speech-to-text models.

methodology.title: Context Extraction
methodology.description: Extracted important concepts, keywords, and contextual information from transcripts using NLP techniques and text preprocessing methods.

methodology.title: Question-Answer Generation
methodology.description: Leveraged AI language models to generate meaningful question-answer pairs from extracted educational content while maintaining contextual relevance.

methodology.title: Dataset Structuring & Storage
methodology.description: Designed a structured storage system to organize generated QA pairs for training, educational platforms, and downstream AI applications.

impact.label: Dataset Creation
impact.description: Reduced manual effort required for generating educational QA datasets from video content.

impact.label: Processing Pipeline
impact.description: Designed the system to process multiple videos efficiently for large-scale dataset generation.

impact.label: Content Understanding
impact.description: Utilized NLP and language models to generate contextually accurate question-answer pairs.

impact.label: Data Organization
impact.description: Generated organized and reusable datasets suitable for AI training and educational applications.
